title: ChunkedText
description: Schema for chunked text output from semantic chunking, preserving per-chunk provenance for downstream embedding and storage.

schema_version.description: The version of this chunked text schema.

patient_id.description: UUID of the patient whose documents were chunked.

chunking_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when chunking was performed.

source_documents.description: List of source document IDs that contributed to the chunks.

chunks.description: Array of text chunks with provenance metadata.

Chunk.description: A single text chunk with sizing and provenance metadata.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based index of this chunk in the sequence.

text.description: The text content of this chunk.

token_count.description: Number of tokens in this chunk.

chunk_hash.description: Hash of the chunk text for deduplication/integrity.

provenance.description: Source provenance entries for this chunk. Multiple entries indicate the chunk spans document boundaries.

ProvenanceEntry.description: Provenance metadata linking chunk content to source document location.

page.description: Page number (1-indexed) in the source document.

coordinates.description: Bounding box coordinates from source document.

start_offset.description: Character offset where this provenance entry starts within the chunk text.

end_offset.description: Character offset where this provenance entry ends within the chunk text.
